Combining these skills, these engineers face challenges across a wide variety of work centers at the company, and the team is frequently asked to tackle new, inter-departmental development projects. The ultimate goal of the Manufacturing team is to ensure that satellites and customers achieve their mission. jobs.description_text: SR. SOFTWARE ENGINEER (COMPONENTS) The Components Team develops and manufactures the most advanced spacecraft and launch vehicle components in the world. Our engineers serve as software and hardware experts for the flow control devices, avionics, and mechanisms that drive the critical capabilities on our Starship, Raptor, Dragon and Falcon vehicles - from engine throttling to attitude control and more. We design and build avionics, valves, regulators, and actuators for maximum performance and reliability in extreme environments, with temperatures ranging from +900F to -400F, pressures beyond 10,000 psig, and actuators above 2,000,000 Newtons. This role will have a strong focus on developing automated tests, maintaining test infrastructure, and ensuring test stands remain reliable and ready to support ongoing flight software development and validation. Spring: Around 16 weeks (January - April) Summer: Around 12 weeks (May - August)

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern (Modeling & Simulation) - Spring/Summer 2027
jobs.description_text: About The Role: As a Modeling & Simulation Software Engineering Intern you will work with the software team to develop performant modeling and simulation code for our 6DOF SITL simulation using Julia. You'll Interface with the Flight Software, HMI, and Flight Sciences teams to meet stakeholder needs and ensure accurate results. Your work will involve creating hardware/physics informed software models and validate results with real data. Fall: Around 16 weeks (August - December)

jobs.title: Sr IT Support Specialist
jobs.description_text: About The Role: As a Senior IT Support Specialist, you will be a senior individual contributor and the hands-on technical anchor for daily IT operations. You will resolve the issues no one else can, mentor junior staff, and own the technical layer beneath the service desk: endpoint management, identity, and endpoint security. We are looking for someone who does not just close tickets but eliminates the work behind them, automating manual processes with PowerShell, replacing one-off fixes with repeatable procedures, and maturing how IT operates as we scale. You will partner closely with our Cyber, Networking, and People teams on work that crosses team boundaries. This role reports to the IT Service Desk Manager and is based on site at our Atlanta, GA office. Two shifts are available, 7:00am to 4:00pm or 9:00am to 6:00pm, with flexibility based on team coverage. After 60 days, you are eligible for one fixed work-from-home day per week (Mondays). Travel to other Hermeus sites runs roughly one to two trips per quarter to support projects and operations.

jobs.title: Structures Engineering Intern - Spring/Summer/Fall 2027
jobs.description_text: About The Role: This role sits at the intersection of engineering design, manufacturing, integration and test for flight vehicles. You'll be embedded with design and production teams, owning everything from hardware design, tooling, testing and flight readiness to process development and vehicle assembly. Spring: Around 16 weeks (January - April) Summer: Around 12 weeks (May - August) Fall: Around 16 weeks (September - December)

jobs.title: Structures/Mechanical Engineering Intern - Spring/Summer 2027
jobs.description_text: About The Role: Hermeus is seeking a hands-on Structures/Mechanical Engineering Intern to support the design, build, and test of flight hardware for next-generation aircraft systems. In this role, you will help design and develop mechanical subassemblies across the vehicle, including control surfaces, landing gear doors, avionics trays, and other flight critical hardware. This internship is ideal for students who enjoy owning real hardware, working in a fast-paced development environment, and taking designs from concept through fabrication, integration, and test. Fall: Around 16 weeks (August - December)

jobs.title: Subsystem Test Engineering Intern - Spring/Summer 2027
jobs.description_text: About The Role: As a Test Engineering Intern at Hermeus, you will play a pivotal role in developing, building, analyzing and operating test assets for our supersonic vehicles. This position offers a unique opportunity to work on groundbreaking technology in a fast-paced and collaborative environment. As part of this team, you will have the opportunity to work on a broad range of vehicle subsystems including hydraulic system, fuel system, mechanisms, high-voltage, mechanisms, airframe structural, and more! Spring: Around 16 weeks (January - April) Summer: Around 12 weeks (May - August)

jobs.title: Supply Chain Intern - Spring/Summer 2027
jobs.description_text: About The Role: We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Supply Chain Intern to support direct materials procurement and help shape the foundation of Hermeus’ supply chain as we scale toward production and qualification. This role will focus on building systems, strengthening supplier infrastructure, and preparing our supply chain for repeatable vehicle builds. Spring: Around 16 weeks (January - April) Summer: Around 12 weeks (May - August)

jobs.title: Technical Sourcer
jobs.description_text: The Technical Sourcer plays a vital role in our recruitment efforts, directly influencing Hermeus' ability to attract and hire top-tier talent. As a key member of our recruiting team, you’ll help shape the company’s talent strategy during a period of rapid growth. This is a hands-on role where you’ll work closely with recruiters and engineering leaders to define and meet hiring needs. You’ll have the autonomy, tools, and support to execute our strategy and help build a world-class team at Hermeus. We’re seeking a Technical Sourcer who can own the entire sourcing process and is excited to make a meaningful impact within a small, fast-moving team. The salary information provided is a general guideline only. Hermeus takes various factors into account, including, but not limited to, the position's scope and responsibilities, the candidate's professional background, education and training, essential skills, and market and business considerations, when presenting a job offer. Hermeus offers competitive salary and equity, unlimited PTO policy, paid parental leave, potential for year-end bonuses, and more! 100% employer-paid health care 401k & Retirement Plans Unlimited PTO Weekly Paid Office Lunches Fully stocked breakrooms Equity Paid Parental Leave

jobs.title: Test and Operations Engineering Intern - Spring/Summer 2027
jobs.description_text: About The Role: As a Test and Operations Engineering Intern at Hermeus, you will support the development, integration, and testing of advanced aircraft systems in a hands-on environment. You will work alongside engineers, technicians, and cross-functional teams to assist with hardware integration, system checkout, development testing, and test readiness activities. This role is ideal for someone interested in engineering operations, test execution, and rapid hardware development. You will help troubleshoot issues, improve procedures, and support the tools and workflows that make vehicle testing safer, faster, and more repeatable. Spring: Around 16 weeks (January - April) Summer: Around 12 weeks (May - August)

jobs.title: Welder
jobs.description_text: About The Role: As a Welder, you will play a key role in fabricating, assembling, and joining structural and piping components critical to our production and mission operations. You’ll work closely with engineering and manufacturing teams to execute precise, high-quality welds across a variety of materials, ensuring all products meet rigorous performance and safety standards. This role is hands-on and suited for an experienced professional who thrives in a fast-paced, technical, and safety-focused environment.

jobs.title: Content Marketing & Editorial, Sr. Manager
jobs.description_text: The Role: IFM is looking for a Content Marketing and Editorial Director to shape the editorial vision and content strategy for IFM. This role will not only lead how IFM communicates its research, Foundational Models and World Models to AI developers, AI industry influencers press, creators, policymakers, and the broader AI community, but also identify emerging trends that help IFM participate at the center of the AI conversation. This is a hands-on role: part strategist, part editor, part publisher. You'll set the narrative, build the processes behind it, and personally shape the flagship pieces that help build the IFM brand. This role is about creating content aligned to IFM’s business objectives with responsibilities covering research “mining” and storytelling, owned channel and content development for launch communications, and thought leadership, community building and forming a point of view that earns the attention of our audience. You'll need to be comfortable translating dense technical work into content that's rigorous enough for experts and clear enough for a broader audience. The role is based in our beautiful new Sunnyvale, CA office. Key Responsibilities Develop and own the editorial voice, calendar and content strategy end-to-end for a deeply technical lab, from long-form narrative to short-form content. Build relationships and partner with IFM engineers so you can sit with them and pull a sharp story out of potentially dense technical work. Own the editorial pi

jobs.description_text: About the Institute of Foundation Models We are a dedicated research lab for building, understanding, using, and risk-managing foundation models. jobs.title: Research Scientist – World Modeling, Data
jobs.description_text: Position Summary We are looking for Research Scientists to tackle the data problems that determine our world model capabilities. You will design, develop, and run state-of-the-art systems for curating, ingesting, filtering, annotating, and training with billion-scale visual data. You will work on problems including, but not limited to, motion scoring, camera control, and video understanding. You will translate our team’s human efforts into durable automated systems, whose performance is quantitatively verifiable. jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description_text: The Role: IFM is looking for a Social Media Manager. Responsibilities cover channel strategy, launch amplification, community building, reporting and day to day posting. Key Responsibilities The Social Media manager is responsible for growing the IFM social channels, including engaging key communities across different audiences relevant to the AI industry.

Create, design and produce graphics, diagrams, and infographics that translate complex research/technical concepts into clear visuals. Produce short-form video content (editing, motion graphics, social/promo clips) as needed. jobs.title: Business Development Director - Healthcare Technology Market (B2B)
jobs.description_text: Research shows that women and underrepresented groups only apply to jobs only if they think they meet 100% of the qualifications on a job description. IMO Health is committed to considering all candidates even if you don’t think you meet 100% of the qualifications listed. We look forward to receiving your application! IMO Health is a clinical data intelligence business at the heart of a digital revolution in healthcare. Combining rich, highly nuanced medical terminology, extensive domain knowledge, and artificial intelligence (AI), we expertly structure and operationalize clinical data to generate sharper insights and inform more intelligent decision-making. Deeply embedded in the provider world, we developed a comprehensive intelligence layer that captures and encodes patient encounters with unmatched completeness and precision. Now, by weaving ethical and accountable AI into this robust content, we are improving how data is used across the healthcare landscape with powerful new applications in health tech, drug discovery, population health, and payer processes. IMO Health is seeking a dynamic and results-driven Business Development Director to join our growth engine/startup Non-Provider Sales Team, an area of heavy investment that reflects our commitment to growth and the future of IMO. jobs.description_text: A Product Manager, Terminology Platform helps define and execute the product strategy for IMO’s foundational terminology platform, including the Knowledge Graph, Reference Data Sets, external content partnerships, and the broader platform capabilities. You will translate market needs, customer commitments, clinical knowledge strategy, and operational priorities into clear roadmaps, requirements, and measurable outcomes. This role requires the ability to connect clinical terminology expertise with product strategy, partner closely across Product, Marketing, Engineering, Legal, Growth, and Customer teams, and drive work that improves content expansion, interoperability, AI-enablement, and customer value.

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer, Applications & Automation
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer to design, build, deploy, and evolve AI models, agents, and workflow automation for clinical terminology and content operations. This hands-on role combines AI/ML development with production ownership, taking models and agents from experimentation to reliable production use. The ideal candidate has experience with large language models, agent frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, and the infrastructure and controls required to operate AI systems reliably.

jobs.title: VP, Provider Revenue Optimization (Portfolio Growth)
jobs.description_text: The VP, Provider Revenue Optimization, is responsible for the growth and market adoption of IMO's Provider product portfolio. The role will focus on translating product investments and market opportunities into customer adoption, market evidence and long-term business value. Working across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance, this leader will develop and drive growth strategies for Provider solutions across their lifecycle, from emerging solutions entering the market to established products with opportunities for greater adoption. The role will define how IMO can maximize the potential of its Provider solutions and align relevant teams across the organization around the actions required to achieve those outcomes. This is a coordinating leadership role. Success depends on influence, credibility and cross-functional partnership rather than direct functional ownership — the role brings structure and shared accountability to commercialization work that today sits across multiple teams. It requires a combination of strategic thinking, commercial judgment, deep market insights, analytical rigor and cross-functional leadership to identify opportunities, diagnose barriers to growth, and mobilize the organization around the actions required to achieve results.

jobs.title: Sales Training and Development Coordinator – Automotive Lending
jobs.description_text: Empower Sales Success Through Training and Development At Lendbuzz, we believe in doing the right thing—for our customers, our team, and our future. We’re defined by diversity, we connect with kindness, we enjoy the ride, and we know that creating means collaborating. As we continue to expand, we’re looking for a passionate and driven Training and Development Coordinator – Automotive Lending to help elevate our sales team to the next level. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, loves to coach and develop sales professionals, and is ready to make a meaningful impact. If you’re eager to build training programs that drive results, collaborate with top talent, and grow your career, this is your opportunity.
